comparison: a value >= its threshold passes; a value < its threshold masks the call
evaluated_calls: diploid biallelic-index calls with no missing allele, phased or unphased; calls already missing or non-standard are not evaluated
masked_genotype: GT alleles replaced by '.', keeping the call's own separator; every other FORMAT subfield is retained unchanged
recomputed_info_scope: only on rows where at least one call was masked; every other INFO annotation describes the original call set and is not recomputed
